### Radical-cure treatment by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Implementation details | Health-system level | Health-system details | Implementation year | Additional safety recommendations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days in areas with low G6PD deficient prevalence and poor adherence to 14-day regimen | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | Strict medical supervision |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | Only with close medical supervision and access to transfusion services |
| **G6PD severely deficient: no definition** | No PQ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ | _Not reported_ |
